Its main weakness is keeping Papyrus; it only flags the font as a problem. B replaces the font well and tidies the alignment, but it keeps the gradient and drop shadow and leaves the tagline at 8px, so its version still wouldn't work in one solid color. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B fixes most of the problems that would show up in use: it removes the drop shadow, flattens the gradient, drops the hairline outline, thickens the route line and enlarges the tagline, giving a reason for each.
